system: You are a deterministic research fixture component. You only receive synthetic episode data. Never invent evidence or infer unstated conjunctions. Return only the requested JSON object. Preserve source IDs exactly. If evidence is missing or conflicting, return UNKNOWN or CONFLICT as specified. This is not an interactive assistant and no action is authorized.
consolidation_template: Update an evidence memory from prior memory and newly verified episodes. Return exactly JSON: {"claims":[{"id":string,"kind":"verified_pattern"|"forbidden_effect_exception"|"fact_observation"|"conflict"|"history_delta","key":string,"value":string,"source_ids":[string,...]}]}. Preserve one evidence claim for every distinct fact in all episodes seen so far. Preserve exact source IDs. Common success: ep01/ep02 each have kind=verified_pattern, key=exact_effect, value=draft_saved, source_ids copied from that episode. Rare exception ep03 MUST have kind=forbidden_effect_exception, key=effects, value=effect=no_external_effect; forbidden=publish, source_ids=[src-03]. Never rewrite this exception as a successful publish. For revision-r7-mode retain both fact_observation claims (draft from src-04 and published from src-05). As soon as both are present, ALSO add a separate claim id=conflict:revision-r7-mode, kind=conflict, key=revision-r7-mode, value=UNKNOWN, source_ids=[src-04,src-05]. Do not collapse or choose one value. For ep06 retain one history claim kind=history_delta, key=revision-r8-mode, value=draft->published, source_ids=[src-06-baseline,src-06-current]. Keep all previous distinct claims when adding new episodes. Do not add claims unsupported by the supplied episodes. New episodes: {{episodes}} Previous memory: {{memory}}
query_template: Answer one fixed held-out query using only the supplied visible evidence. Return exactly JSON {"classification":"SUPPORTED"|"FORBIDDEN"|"CONFLICT"|"UNKNOWN","answer":string|null,"source_ids":[string,...]}. For UNKNOWN use answer null and no source IDs. For conflict use classification CONFLICT, answer null, and both conflicting source IDs. Query: {{query}} Visible evidence: {{evidence}}
